name: How often should I repaint my interior ceiling?

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint my interior ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceiling paint in Denver-area homes typically lasts **5 to 10 years**, but kitchens, bathrooms, and other high-moisture or high-use rooms often need repainting sooner. If you see yellowing, stains, cracking, or patchiness, it is usually time to refresh the ceiling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most ceilings last 5–10 years, but kitchens and bathrooms often need repainting sooner. Stains, yellowing, or cracking are common signs it is time.
